youtube_title: Stock Fell 25%. With 4x MTF, You Lost 100% 💀 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: the stock fell 25% and you bought with 4x margin. How much of your money is left?

Sid has ₹25,000 and buys ₹1 lakh with MTF. Stock falls 25%: ₹1 lakh becomes ₹75,000, and the broker wants its ₹75,000 back with interest. Sid's ₹25,000? Zero. A 25% fall wiped out 100% of his money. MTF is a loan, with interest every day.

Rule: don't buy with borrowed money unless you can take the full loss. Start small with your own money.
Moral: Leverage multiplies mistakes, not just profits.

Source: MTF leverage up to 4x (PPFAS via Business Today, Feb 2026)
Education only, not investment advice.
